$meta.name: Babel shared limits
$meta.description: Numeric and string bounds that MORE THAN ONE repo enforces independently. A client maxLength that disagrees with the server is a defect class of its own: either the user is blocked from something valid, or they type past a limit and get a 400 at submit.
$meta.inclusionRule: ONLY bounds measured to AGREE at every site that declares them. A bound the repos DISAGREE about is not canon by fiat — picking the winner is an owner decision, and those are listed under `$conflicts` instead so the decision has its evidence attached.

$conflicts.note: Measured disagreements. NOT shipped as rules — each needs an owner decision, and each is a live defect today.
$conflicts.uploadMaxBytes: api 50MB (association-document.controller.ts:44, storage.schema.ts:69) vs admin 10MB (documents/page.tsx:100, and a HARD 10MB ceiling in admin's own Next proxy at api/proxy/[...path]/route.ts:321) vs mobile 10MB (hoa_file_provider.dart:13). Five numbers across the surfaces: 5/10/15/50/100MB. Admin's messages page allows 100MB (messages/page.tsx:127) — 10x its own proxy cap, so those uploads cannot succeed.
$conflicts.taskAttachmentMaxBytes: api 15MB (task-document.controller.ts:235) and mobile 15MB (create_task_screen.dart:965) AGREE — but admin's proxy caps at 10MB, so a 10-15MB task attachment the API accepts is rejected before it leaves admin. Left out because adopting 15MB in admin would break against admin itself.
$conflicts.uploadAllowedTypes: api presigned allows 15 MIME types incl. webp/heic (storage.schema.ts:13-27); api multipart allows 11 extensions with NO webp and NO heic (association-document.controller.ts:43); mobile lets the user PICK heic/webp (create_task_screen.dart:966). A phone photo can be chosen and then refused.
$conflicts.otpResendCooldownSeconds: api 30s (user-auth.service.ts:831, contact-verification.service.ts:51) but 60s in vendor-claim.service.ts:60 — the API disagrees with ITSELF. Both clients use 60s (admin security.ts:144, mobile verify_move_email.dart:90), so users wait twice as long as they must.
$conflicts.otpMaxAttempts: api 5 (utils/constants.ts:61) counts WRONG-CODE attempts per issued code; mobile 3 (login_provider.dart:83) counts SEND attempts per 10-minute window. Different numbers AND different semantics — this one needs a definition before it can have a value.
$conflicts.phoneMaxLength: api 32 (user.schema.ts:182) vs api 50 (vendor.schema.ts:160, vendor-claim.schema.ts:106). Neither client declares one.
$conflicts.emailMaxLength: mobile 100 everywhere (text_field.dart:227 shared default); api and admin declare NO bound. Mobile silently truncates addresses the other two accept.
$conflicts.listPageSize: task list: api has NO .max() at all (task.schema.ts:285,332,451,579,591,602), admin 50, mobile 30. audit trail: api 50, admin 50, mobile 30. purchase orders: api max 500/default 50, admin 25 AND 50 in two files, mobile 25. Page size is probably a per-surface product decision rather than a contract.
